title: AURA-VERIFIER — Independent CLI and Browser Verifier (v1.2.1)
description: Independent open-source CLI and browser verifier for AURA evidence packages. Version 1.2.1 corrects the browser integrity explanation when an asset is supplied but no hash is declared in the manifest. It distinguishes a missing file from a missing declared hash, preserves a general explanation for malformed or unsupported hash declarations, and adds seven browser regression cases including empty files. It retains the cryptographic engines and acceptance policies of v1.2.0: Ed25519 signatures, SHA3-256 exact-byte integrity, RFC 8785/JCS canonicalization, strict input checks, caller-supplied issuer registry checks and optional detached RFC 3161 timestamp verification through Node and local OpenSSL. Supported manifest versions remain exactly 1.0 and 1.1. Signature validity, file integrity and supplied key status are reported separately; identity, authority, ownership, registry authenticity and freshness, historical validity and qualified eIDAS timestamp status are not established. Verification requires no AUTHENTICA account or backend. Frozen schemas, signed evidence and historical archives remain unchanged.
